scientific_integrity: The main converse is an explicit analytic reversible binary-switch realization. Forward covariance-to-kurtosis and positive spectral formula were already in literature. Finite examples supplement rather than establish the general result.
scientific_limitations: Assumes a stationary irreducible reversible finite-state Markov diffusivity independent of the driving Brownian motion; positive diffusivity is not upper bounded. No statement about full distributions, noisy inverse recovery, continuum-state, or nonequilibrium processes. Full text of two plausible comparison publications unavailable; priority risk remains.
title: Exact realizability of finite spectral kurtosis laws by positive Markov-switching diffusivities
